facts.text: It was a habitable world, with an atmosphere that was made up mainly of nitrogen and oxygen, and a mean temperature of 40 °C.

evidence.quote: It was a habitable world, with an atmosphere that was made up mainly of nitrogen and oxygen, and a mean temperature of 40 °C.

facts.text: An interesting feature of Nyriaan was the effect that its atmosphere had on the Force.
